ROOT.triggerdef: CREATE TRIGGER CDN.Rejestry_UsunZFormPlatnosci ON CDN.Rejestry FOR DELETE AS SET NOCOUNT ON UPDATE CDN.FrmObiekty set FrO_GID2Numer = 0 FROM CDN.FrmObiekty, deleted WHERE deleted.KAR_GIDNumer = CDN.FrmObiekty.FRO_GID2Numer AND CDN.FrmObiekty.Fro_GIDTyp=736 AND CDN.FrmObiekty.Fro_GID2Typ=752 SET NOCOUNT OFF
